pressRelease.title: SnapSong Launches, Turning Any Photo Into a Complete Original Song With AI
pressRelease.subtitle: iOS 26 app uses Apple Foundation Models on-device to generate songs with vocals, lyrics, and cover art from a single photo — built by a 3× WWDC Scholar and Apple Developer Academy alumnus
pressRelease.dateline: PORTO ALEGRE, Brazil — April 20, 2026 — TrueTapp today announced the launch of SnapSong, an iOS app that transforms any photo into a complete original song — with AI-generated vocals, lyrics, and custom album art — in minutes. Built natively for iOS 26 and powered by Apple Foundation Models, SnapSong is available now on the App Store for iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Apple Silicon.
pressRelease.kind: SnapSong is the first app of its kind. Instead of asking users to describe the music they want, it reads the scene in their photos — a sunset, a road trip, a dog in the backyard — and composes a song that matches the emotion of the image. Users pick a photo and, minutes later, get a full song. Optional keywords (a name, a memory, a feeling) make the result more personal. Every generation produces two unique versions.
pressRelease.tech: The app is built entirely on Apple's latest technologies: the Liquid Glass visual language of iOS 26, ActivityKit for Live Activities and Dynamic Island, WidgetKit for Home Screen widgets, and Apple Foundation Models for an on-device Creative Intelligence engine — which analyzes each user's song history to suggest fresh directions and avoid repetitive output, entirely without sending data to the cloud. SnapSong ships with full accessibility support: VoiceOver, Voice Control, Larger Text, Dark Interface, Sufficient Contrast, and Reduced Motion.
pressRelease.quote: "Photos are silent memories. We take hundreds of them — sunsets, people we love, random beautiful moments — and they stay silent. I wanted to change that," said Henrique Velloso, founder of TrueTapp and creator of SnapSong. "SnapSong isn't a tool for musicians. It's for everyone — your mom at a birthday party, a kid pointing a camera at their dog. One photo, one song. That's the whole idea."
pressRelease.bio: Velloso is a three-time WWDC Scholarship winner (2015, 2017, 2018) and an alumnus of one of the first Apple Developer Academy cohorts worldwide. He has been building for Apple platforms for over a decade.
pressRelease.availabilityBody: SnapSong is available today on the App Store. Premium plans are priced at $9.99/week and $49.99/year. Songs and lyrics are generated in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, and German — auto-detected from the device language. All personal data stays on the user's device.
pressRelease.aboutBody: TrueTapp is an independent Apple-platforms studio based in Brazil, founded by Henrique Velloso. Its published apps include Messenger Multi for AI, Cartoon Maker – ToonFilter, RePrompt, and Trap Raider.
